title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Vehicle Age Limit and Eligible Listing Classes by Plan
content:
## Entry conditions for a Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan

Each Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan sets the oldest vehicle it will cover, counted in whole years,
and the Keyturn Vehicle Listing value classes it will cover. Each plan also states whether the vehicle
must carry an active listing. On every plan the subscription is held by the member in the role of host.

| Plan | Oldest vehicle covered (whole years) | An active Keyturn Vehicle Listing required | Eligible listing value classes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | 15 | no | Keyturn Economy Class Listing; Keyturn Standard Class Listing |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | 13 | yes | Keyturn Economy Class Listing; Keyturn Standard Class Listing; Keyturn Premium Class Listing |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | 12 | yes | Keyturn Economy Class Listing; Keyturn Standard Class Listing; Keyturn Premium Class Listing; Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | 10 | yes | Keyturn Standard Class Listing; Keyturn Premium Class Listing; Keyturn Luxury Class Listing |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | 12 | yes | Keyturn Economy Class Listing; Keyturn Standard Class Listing; Keyturn Premium Class Listing; Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | 8 | yes | Keyturn Premium Class Listing; Keyturn Luxury Class Listing; Keyturn Exotic Class Listing |

### The same schedule read by listing class

| Listing value class | Plans that carry it |
| --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | Basic, Plus, Tow and Fleet Cover |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | Basic, Plus, Tow, EV and Fleet Cover |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | Plus, Tow, EV, Fleet and Concierge Cover |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | EV and Concierge Cover |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | Concierge Cover |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | Tow and Fleet Cover |

An active listing is asked for on every plan except Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover. The age limit stands at
15 whole years on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, 13 on Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, 12 on both Keyturn
Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover, 10 on Keyturn Roadside EV Cover and 8 on Keyturn
Roadside Concierge Cover.
